findings.text: The task folder holds no evidence of the claimed headless proof ("1 of 8 done", "2 of 8" with no reload, a ninth task live): there is no shots/ folder and no proof file beside requirements.md, so a fresh agent cannot check it. Save the screenshots or the probe output into the task folder and link them from requirements.md.

The checklist is the owner's visible ask, but the diff has no UI test for the new card: LivePage.test.mjs:114-124 only covers the data list and the change event. Add a check (or kept probe) that LivePage.Tasks draws the "Tasks · N of M done" title and one row per task, so a regression in LivePage.js:802-820 is caught.

LivePage.js:49 hides the card on focus, screen and settings views, so it appears only on the page itself. This matches "above its cards", but neither requirements.md nor readme.md says it is hidden on sub-views; one sentence in the readme row would settle it.
The readme row (public/live/readme.md:108) is indexed, but live/doc/page-features.md is not updated and the live-r13 landing is not listed there. Add a line if that doc is the feature index.

The comment block above LivePage.Tasks (LivePage.js:799-801) sits between the Pages comment and `static Pages`. The Pages description now reads as if it belongs to Tasks; move the Tasks block above the Pages comment.

LivePage.js:49 sets `this.tasks.of = Task` after constructing `Task.List`, duplicating what Task.js:55 does; fine, but `new Task.List({ owner, name, of: Task })` would be simpler if List accepts `of`.

Simpler-way check: reusing TaskView.row with CSS overrides (LivePage.css:191-199) is sound and avoids a second row view, as the decisions say. The `.task-row:has(.is-complete)` dimming depends on TaskView's class names; core/Task changes could silently break it.

answer.reply: fixed: the probe, its output and two shots are saved in live-r13/shots/ (live-tick.txt: 1 of 8, then 2 of 8 and a ninth row with no reload) and linked from requirements.md.

declined: LivePage.Tasks draws only in a browser (node has no DOM here); its test is the saved browser probe shots/tick.mjs, which checks the title and the row count live. LivePage.test covers the list and the change event.
fixed: the readme row now says the card shows on the page itself, not on a saved screen, an opened card or settings (052f744ee).
noted: live/readme.md is the feature index for deltas; the row is there.
fixed: the Tasks comment now sits above its own class (052f744ee).
noted: List takes no `of` option; it is set after construction, as Task.js does.
noted: the class names are TaskView's one row look; a rename there would show at once on /live/.

log.msg: Review answered; merging live-r13 (page tasks checklist, qsglj96w).

complete.outcome: A page's tasks show as one live checklist card on /live/ (Tasks · N of M done); tasks.add no longer replaces the last.
